description: Input: the same fields as quote_revision, plus max_credits, attempt. A new run rendering a make_faceless video again with changes or document (exactly one). Repeating an identical request returns the run it started, starting nothing new; pass attempt 2 for another one. A revision that delivers is charged its quoted total; one that fails is charged nothing. A refusal names its limit. While paid edits are closed it answers editing_disabled and charges nothing. Poll get_run. Price: each shot generated anew: picture 7, clip 49, clip with a new picture 56; plus 13 to render. A revision that generates nothing: 13. A kept candidate adds nothing. Quote first with quote_revision.
name: revise_run
title: Revise a run
